description: E6spoof with the execution credential: every call of a restricted execution runs a tool whose child process tries to switch its credential to a permissive execution's (prctl(PR_FACT, set, id)) before connecting. Without trust, the BPF LSM program on task_prctl accepts the switch; with trust (only the MCP server process may switch), the kernel refuses it (EPERM) and the child keeps the credential it inherited at clone. Automatic binding; same reference (exclusive destination port).
